title: New Onecoin presentation 2017
description: OneCoin cryptocurrency is changing the world: https://www.onelife.eu/signup/djammy33.

asr.full_text: What is OneCoin ? Millions of people around the world are mining OneCoin today. The reason? It's a platform for innovation, that changes the financial industry. Put simply, it gives instant access to easier, faster and low-cost financial services. You do not need to go to your traditional financial institution or escrow agent to send money to your loved ones. Fast. we make transactions every minute hence you are able to send money from any part of the world to another in a minute easy everyone can transfer money with OneCoin you only need your phone to do so safe and most importantly mining the coin transferring money and making payments with Onetcoin is absolutely safe. When joining OneCoin we automatically create an e-wallet for you. Because of our centralized model we take care of all technical aspects, ensuring that your mined coins are safe. What's more, to prevent money laundering, identity theft, financial fraud, and terrorist financing, OneCoin has implemented KYC procedures, thus preventing any possible misconduct by its clients. OneCoin also became the first cryptocurrency with a monthly audit of its blockchain! People join OneCoin for a reason… To learn about cryptocurrency. To mine the coin. To transfer money, to make payments without the need for expensive or unsafe intermediaries, to deposit money and to save over 80%. Inspired by Dr. Ružek Gnatova's strong vision to provide access to financial services for everyone regardless of income social status and ethnicity ONE COIN has become a global company with a community of thousands of miners worldwide in just over a year. ONE world, ONE COIN join the financial revolution

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it promotes OneCoin as a global financial platform, makes strong safety and audit assurances, claims users can save over 80%, and directs viewers to a OneLife signup link. It encourages participation by presenting mining and joining OneCoin as an accessible financial revolution rather than warning about or critically examining the offer.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: S04 is the closest primary subtype because the promotion centers on joining and mining OneCoin while linking that participation to financial-service benefits and substantial savings. The supplied content does not explicitly show a purchase of a mining package or node, so the subtype assignment is based on the mining-participation mechanism and its advertised financial benefits rather than an invented payment step.
